items.problem: Bootstrap inventory omitted linked MSBuild items outside the project directory.
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[1] and skill-defects.json items[0]: 4 files copied, 17 linked items omitted, approximately ten turns spent on manual recovery.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 relied only on recursive directory enumeration below -Source.
items.change: Parse explicit Compile, Page, ApplicationDefinition, Content, and AppxManifest items; resolve Include paths; copy existing files to validated Link destinations; include them in mapping and triage.
items.expected_effect: Shared UWP shell, page, code, and asset files arrive in the target automatically, eliminating generated-output archaeology and manual reconstruction.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on the same source reports 21 seeded rows, copies all 17 linked items, and leaves none of the nine representative linked destinations missing.

items.problem: Win2D UWP dependency was not translated to a WinUI-compatible package.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json items[1] and scoring lines 726/730/735/739 show unresolved Canvas types while the source csproj references Win2D.uwp.
items.root_cause: Package guidance treated project-specific libraries generically and omitted framework-specific package-ID replacement.
items.change: Add an explicit Win2D.uwp to Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D mapping and dependency-first diagnosis rule.
items.expected_effect: Agents retain Win2D-backed features with the correct WinUI package instead of deleting code or carrying an incompatible UWP package.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the target csproj references Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D and emits no CS0234/CS0246 errors for Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas types.

items.problem: Common name collisions produced CS0118 for platform types and CS0104 for DispatcherQueue.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json items[2], skill-coverage-gaps.json items[0], and scoring lines 727-740.
items.root_cause: The app-name namespace shadowed a platform type, while the threading recipe did not address a retained Windows.System import.
items.change: Add a CS0118 alias/qualification pattern and sharpen the existing threading section with a Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue alias example.
items.expected_effect: Agents resolve contextual compiler collisions surgically without risky namespace-wide renames or removing needed imports.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, no CS0118 platform-type shadowing or CS0104 DispatcherQueue ambiguity remains.
